text: 宁德时代公告，2026年10月15日于深圳证券交易所购回A股68.95万股，每股购回价介乎人民币277.98元至280元，付出价格总额人民币1.92亿元。
text_en: CATL announced that on October 15, 2026, it repurchased 689,500 A-shares on the Shenzhen Stock Exchange at a repurchase price of between RMB 277.98 and RMB 280 per share, with a total payment of RMB 192 million.
